newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London gain ground as Dow advances.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London gain ground as Dow advances.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London recovered some of their recent losses on Friday, boosted by a bounce on Wall Street, dealers said.
By 1500 GMT the Hang Seng London Reference Index was 74.55 points firmer at 12,811.08. In Hong Kong earlier, the Hang Seng closed 180.56 points lower at 12,736.53.
Dealers said trade was thin, with most action centred on HSBC which was $2.00 higher than its Hong Kong close.
"There's not been a lot of action. It's been marked up on the back of a strong Wall Street," one dealer said.
